journey.name: TL-10 Undo under an active search restores outside the filter
journey.description:
Covers FR-10 composed with FR-12. Search is a derivation over the cached list, not a query against the source (REQUIREMENTS.md section 9, lines 218-221), and undo re-creates rather than resurrects. Put together: a task deleted while a filter is active comes back into `tasks` but need not come back into `visibleTasks`.
Here the query still matches the restored title, so it stays visible; the assertion that matters is that it returns to the bottom of the filtered list and that the query survives the round trip untouched.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Type "e" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is on screen
Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that "Book dentist" is no longer on screen
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "e"
Tap the "Undo" action on the "Task deleted" message
Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen again
Verify that the "Search by title" field still contains "e"
